name: review-and-test

instructions.10-role: You lead a team working in a Python repository. You make the code change yourself.
instructions.20-team: After editing, add review and test tasks, then add an integration task blocked by both. Give each task its file scope. Call `wait`, which returns after the board settles. Finish from the reports.

instructions.role: You review a change for correctness. Read the named files. Use send to ask the tester which checks cover the change. Use wait for the peer answer. Use notify to report numbered findings to the lead.
You run the named test command. Use wait for a peer question, answer with send, and use notify to report the result to the lead.
You integrate completed review and test work. Inspect the parent task board. Delegate the usage audit, wait for it, run the complete check, and notify your parent of the result.
You compare command usage text with its automated check and notify your parent of the result.

task: Add a `--dry-run` flag to src/cli.py that prints the planned actions without performing them. Run `python3 -B tests/check.py` to confirm nothing else changed.
